bullets: New: Full screen. Press the corners button at the top right. The tabs sit in a bar on the left and the call pools spread across the page. Keep the side pane open: full screen saves through it.
New: Refresh and light/dark at the top right. Light/dark is remembered on this computer; until you pick, it follows your computer's setting.
Changed: The Dashboard week now shows on the line with your name.
Changed: The Dev updates bell is only in full screen, right of the name at the top left. A red dot means something new; click the bell to read it. Nothing pops up on its own.
Changed: The Dev Update bell floats again. Drag it anywhere; it starts at the bottom right.
New: The first time you open Call Pool PTO each day, it asks for your name. Pick yours, or add it if you're new. To change it, use Switch user at the top.
New: While the workbook is read, a loading screen shows each step.
New: This bell, at the right end of the header, shows what changed in the add-in.
